_comment_checkpoints: Full-protocol reproduction checkpoints (0-reproduction), NOT the PADS training runs. These reach 72.8-73.5% IoU under the reference macro-imagewise metric; the PADS checkpoints under runs/ are ~0.35 pooled IoU and carry the two accuracy defects documented in Appendix B. Verified to load into 3-pads/<arch>/model.py::ArcheoModel with strict=True.
_comment_input: reconstruct_render_manifest.py writes filename as a bare 'tile_NNNNNN.jpg' (no directory part), and infer_tiles.run() resolves images as tiles_root/filename, so tiles_root must be the image directory itself, not the project root.

SCRATCH allows 10T and holds 143.9M. /scratch_out is bound to /mnt/scratch/users/nahsan/discovery by ops/run_discovery.slurm.
